title: Customers counts update straight after a move
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves three Net 15 customers to Net 20, and you check both counts.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 15 is held by {Count-A} customers and Net 20 by {Count-B}, written down; three of the Net 15 customers are {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C}.
    For example: {Count-A} is 7, {Count-B} is 2 and the three are ZZAUTOTEST DATA-23 Alpha to Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 15" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Tick {Customer-A}.
  5. Tick {Customer-B}.
  6. Tick {Customer-C}.
  7. Choose "Net 20" in "Move To".
  8. Click "Move 3 Customers".
  9. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the window shows "{Count-A} selected" (for example "7 selected").
  • Step 3: "0 selected".
  • Step 4: "1 selected".
  • Step 5: "2 selected".
  • Step 6: "3 selected"; the button reads "Move 3 Customers".
  • Step 7: the dropdown shows Net 20.
  • Step 8: the toast reads "3 customers moved to Net 20." and, without reloading, Net 15 reads {Count-A} − 3 (for example 4) and Net 20 reads {Count-B} + 3 (for example 5).
  • Step 9: the counts are the same after the reload.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S1-R12: “The Customers column shows how many customers hold the term, right aligned, showing 0 when none. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer with a blank term is counted under COD. Names that differ only in capitals and spaces count toward the same term ("NET 30" counts as Net 30; see §6).”
